race.comment: Former NSW galloper BRITISH NAVY (2) is unlucky to still be a maiden hitting the top-four in all four runs since joining the new stable and strikes a very winnable contest here. Has placed two of three around this circuit and gets a bunch of weight relief with the 3kg claim. Should be right there at the business end. BOOM CHIKA WOW (8) was well in the betting here on debut but just ran into a couple better on that occasion. Where there's smoke there's fire and can feature with natural improvement. ENTERPRISE VALOUR (3) resumes from a lengthy spell but has tuned up for this with a recent trial victory and any market confidence must be respected. RATTLESNAKEWHISKEY (9) has finished runner-up at the last couple and may earn some minor money again. RED SCENTSATION (10) next in line while fresh.
